day1_insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so stormwater runoff isn't a factor right now. The model's main signals right now: high tide timing is lowering risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; high tide level is lowering risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls; and no rain has fallen, so nothing is washing off the land into the surf. The most recent sample, 5 days ago, was excellent at 5 MPN/100mL.
